title: Determining $\mathbb R$-Rank in Semisimple Lie Groups via uniform approximate Lattice arising as Regular Model Sets
summary: Let $G$ be a linear semisimple Lie group without compact factors. We show that uniform approximate lattices $Λ$ arising as regular model sets in $G$ determine the ambient group $G$ in a strong sense. Specifically, for every non-compact Cartan subgroup $C$ of $G$, there exists $g \in G$ such that the intersection $gCg^{-1} \cap Λ^2$ is non-empty and itself forms a uniform approximate lattice, extending a classical result of Mostow for lattices.
